cost: For input byte length B, normalization and lookup cost O(B) time and O(B) allocation; enum/name/version operations cost O(1). Fixed alphabet sizes seven and two.
description: Normalize with trim and Unicode lowercase, then search literal seven QType or two ExIm names; Rule admits only byte 1 or 2. Domain: all supplied UTF-8 strings and u8 values; observation: Option enum, canonical name or numeric version. Exact scoped formula, not a performance surrogate.
forward: Normalize with trim and Unicode lowercase, then search literal seven QType or two ExIm names; Rule admits only byte 1 or 2. Domain: all supplied UTF-8 strings and u8 values; observation: Option enum, canonical name or numeric version. Exact scoped formula, not a performance surrogate.
inverse: For accepted t, all s with lowercase(trim(s))=name(t) are compatible; rejected output collects every other string. Canonical name and version number uniquely recover their enum inside these closed alphabets.
limitations: Finite synthetic checks only; no teacher/parser/data acquisition.
state: ALL order is stable; canonical names are unique; parse(name(t))=Some(t); Rule::of(r.num())=Some(r).
